answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one nebula weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 226 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 201 times the capital for one share. The spiral report makes public the merge explicitly at each lagoon. A farm of 3473 identities would post 3055 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
